court: Court of Appeal of Louisiana, Fourth Circuit
holding_summary: The court held that the City's suit to enjoin a guest house from renting rooms for transient (under-sixty-day) occupancy in a residential zoning district was barred by the two-year peremptive period of La. R.S. 9:5625, because the City had actual written notice of the zoning violation by October 31, 1989, before it filed suit on November 15, 1991. As a result, the guest house's expanded transient-occupancy use acquired legal nonconforming status.

quotes.text: from renting rooms at 705 and 709 Burgundy Street for transient occupancy (less than sixty days) in violation of the Comprehensive Zoning Ordinance (CZO Art. 5, § 18.2 and Art. 12, § 5).

St. Peter, Inc. caused, allowed and/or permitted the expansion of a nonconforming use by allowing 705 and 709 Burgundy to be utilized as part of St. Peter House (a |2guest house used for transient occupation).
the units of St. Peter Guest House at 705-709 Burgundy St. acquired and shall enjoy legal non-conforming status.
Prescription had accrued and the City’s petition for an injunction | gwas barred when it was filed on November 15, 1991.

notes: Substantive dispute is procedural (peremption/notice), not a holding on the legality of transient letting itself; adverse regulatory framework (CZO bar on transient occupancy) coexists with a practical favorable outcome (continued nonconforming use) for the operator.

court: Court of Appeal of Louisiana, Third Circuit
notes: Community home for mentally retarded adults under a subdivision restrictive covenant ('single family dwelling') dispute; discusses lodger/boarder definitions only via quotation of another case to distinguish the group home from boarding houses, not as its own holding on compensated short-term letting.

court: Court of Appeal of Louisiana, Third Circuit
notes: Divorce community-property partition; dispute over rental value/reimbursement between former spouses as co-owners occupying jointly owned home, governed by co-ownership law, not paid third-party lodging.

court: Court of Appeal of Louisiana, Third Circuit
notes: Community property partition applying McCarroll co-ownership rent principles to a spouse's exclusive occupancy of the former community home; not a third-party paid short-term letting arrangement.

Zoning dispute over whether a state-licensed community home for six mentally retarded persons qualifies as a 'single family dwelling'; permanent group residential placement, not compensated short-term lodging.

Constitutional challenge to a zoning ordinance's definition of 'family' as applied to a landlord leasing an entire house to four unrelated tenants; ordinary long-term tenancy/occupancy-limit dispute, not short-term lodging or boarding-house regulation.

court: Court of Appeal of Louisiana, Third Circuit
notes: Divorce community-property partition; rent offset/mortgage reimbursement dispute between former spouses over the former family home, governed by La. R.S. 9:374 and co-ownership doctrine only.

court: Court of Appeal of Louisiana, Third Circuit
notes: Statutory construction of the 'bona fide hotel' exception to alcohol-permit distance restrictions near churches/playgrounds; no facts about the legal character of room letting or lodging.

court: Court of Appeal of Louisiana, First Circuit
notes: Zoning classification dispute over operation of a barroom and liquor-permit timeliness; unrelated to lodging or short-term letting of dwellings.

court: Court of Appeal of Louisiana, Fourth Circuit
notes: Criminal murder/self-defense appeal turning on jury instructions; the victims' bed-and-breakfast business ('Hawthorne House') is incidental background to a business-partner homicide dispute, not a holding on the legal character of the letting.

court: Court of Appeal of Louisiana, Fifth Circuit
notes: Slip-and-fall premises liability action against a hotel franchisor, resolved on custody/control under a trademark licensing agreement; no issue regarding the character of guest room letting.

court: Court of Appeal of Louisiana, Fourth Circuit
notes: Liquor-permit denial dispute over a bar's nonconforming use claim tied to a hotel; concerns alcohol licensing, not the legal character of room letting or lodging.

notes: Earlier appellate round of the Normal Life community-home zoning dispute (see case_id 12120518); same permanent group-home subject matter, not compensated short-term lodging.

court: Court of Appeal of Louisiana, First Circuit
notes: Building-restriction dispute over a group/community home for mentally retarded individuals ('single family dwelling' covenant); not compensated short-term lodging.

notes: Building-restriction dispute over a community home for retarded citizens, decided on failure to obtain statutory site approval; not compensated short-term lodging.

court: Court of Appeal of Louisiana, First Circuit
notes: Eviction of a permissive, largely rent-free 'occupant' under La. C.C.P. arts. 4701-4704 after the accommodation's purpose (family members living out their lives on the land) ceased; not a compensated short-term letting arrangement.

court: Court of Appeal of Louisiana, Second Circuit
notes: Eviction and ownership dispute over an annually-leased marina cabin lot and the separately owned cabin structure; a long-term annual predial lease and component-ownership dispute, not short-term paid lodging.
